proofs.text: Read `tools/PM/purlin-anchor-userstories.md`; verify `[risk:`, `[origin:` and `[criterion:` each appear, that `[risk: high]`, `[risk: medium]` and `[risk: low]` each appear, that the file carries the sentence "Under the `approved` gate risk and origin are both required", that `@integration`, `@e2e` and `@manual` each appear, and that `@env(windows)`, `@env(macos)` and `@env(linux)` each appear. Dropping the `@env` sentence fails naming `@env(macos)`

rule_text: The skill names the three rule tags `[risk: ...]`, `[origin: ...]` and `[criterion: ...]` with their values, says risk and origin are both required under the `approved` gate, and names the four proof tiers and the three `@env` values

tests.body:
def test_it_names_the_tags_and_the_tiers(self):
        assert carries(PM_MD, [
            '[risk:', '[origin:', '[criterion:', '`[risk: high]`',
            '`[risk: medium]`', '`[risk: low]`',
            'Under the `approved` gate risk and origin are both required',
            '@integration', '@e2e', '@manual',
            '@env(windows)', '@env(macos)', '@env(linux)']) == []
tests.name: test_it_names_the_tags_and_the_tiers
